_approach: The default Amapiano engine: a soft, spaced kick (not full 4x4 - Splice/Roland both stress it stays out of the log drum's way), a continuous 16th shaker as the timekeeping backbone, log drum stepwise-motion hits (tomLow+congaLow) syncopated around the kick, and offbeat open hats. NOTE: tomLow+congaLow approximate the log drum's RHYTHM only - the real log drum is a tuned, pitch-bent kick/808/bass hybrid this drum-only library cannot reproduce; the melodic/bass part must come from a synth. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
